metadata.name: Whiteout Station
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: An arctic research outpost on the shore of a frozen lake (Style Pack 12: Snow Outpost). The Embers hold the vehicle hangar and barracks on the south shore; the Tide hold the radar dome, the comms mast and their barracks on the north shore. Cross the lake between pressure ridges (mind the thin ice over the holes), take the frozen ridge in the west up its snow drifts (the sniper waits up there), or push up the east side past the bunkers, along the pipe catwalk and the snow road where the snowmobiles run. Climb onto hut and barracks roofs by their outside stairs; roll the hangar door down from the button inside.
